amazon_movers_shakers.error: Amazon scrape returned nothing usable for any category. Amazon actively blocks scraping from datacenter IPs (which GitHub Actions runners are) — this is the most likely source to fail here. If it consistently fails, drop it from the automated pipeline and have Nova check Movers & Shakers live via Claude in Chrome instead when asked, rather than fighting Amazon's bot detection for free.
